items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: The interviewee mentions Gene Quill in the context of Al Cohn naming a group 'Leopold and Loeb' consisting of Gene Quill and Phil Woods, and the interviewer asks about 'Marijuana Reeds' with Gene Quill, but the interviewee does not describe a personal interaction or professional collaboration with Q

ctx.x: Yeah, so instead of the Tijuana Brass they called them the Marijuana Reeds.
A group that Al Cohn named, it was Gene Quill and Phil Woods, he called them Leopold and Loeb.
People will have to work that out.
